title: hedysarum hedysaroides subsp. branthii
intro: Hedysarum hedysaroides subsp. branthii, commonly known as the Norwegian sweetvetch or branth's sweetvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It is a perennial herb that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The health benefits of Hedysarum hedysaroides subsp. branthii include its potential use in treating digestive issues, inflammation, and as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
